trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion.
steps: Finish the story, all stranger strands, all collectibles and all activities.
Use the in-game stats page to find what is left, then clear it stage by stage.
Gold: this is the long one — it is the platinum roadmap's final step.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida.
steps: Stunts count in free roam: jumps, near misses, drifts and air time.
Chain them on long highway runs and at jump spots; the counter is in the stats page.
Silver: a grind trophy — chip at it between missions rather than in one sitting.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once.
steps: Open the activities list and try one of each type the game offers.
Nine types are listed in the official data — work down the list in free roam.
Any single try counts; you do not need to win or finish one.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and work through its 42 challenges.
Gold each one: learn the target pattern first, then go for the gold time or score.
Silver: the hardest grind here is the later challenges — save this for stage 3.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Find each Top Fun Drone Race location around Leonida.
Win one race at each — the official description does not name how many locations there are, so check them off as you find them.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races.
steps: Enter races around Leonida — street, off-road and any other race type the game offers.
Each different race won counts once toward the 20.
A fast car and a clean first lap matter more than a perfect car.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
steps: Collect cards around Leonida and complete 3 full sets.
Cards are a collectible: check them off in the tracker as you find them.
Silver: a completionist trophy — save it for the stage 2 cleanup.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations.
steps: Find the WAiNK spots around Leonida and use one at each.
100 locations: work through the map region by region so none is missed.
Silver: a long collectible grind — pair it with the vehicle and exploration cleanup.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges.
steps: Challenges are the game's side tasks — open the challenges list and work through it.
50 completions across any challenge types count.
Chip at these during the story; the rest fall in the stage 3 grind.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Build a 4 star Wanted Level while playing with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight, lose the cops and let the stars clear.
Do it in the countryside where there is room to run.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop, then immediately rob a second and a third.
Keep the same Wanted Level running across all three — do not let it clear between shops.
Pick three shops close together on a quiet street.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles.
steps: Drive or enter 100 different vehicles across Leonida.
Every new model you get into counts once.
Variety beats speed: try boats, bikes, trucks and cars alike.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Build up Combat Focus, then trigger it with at least 5 enemies close together.
Take all 5 down before the focus ends.
A crowded firefight is the place for it — do not waste it on one or two enemies.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport and leave in a way the airport did not schedule.
The official description does not name the exact trick — try the runway in a fast vehicle or on foot through a restricted area.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos.
steps: Get into a Rhino tank and cause trouble with it.
The official description is a joke, not a set of steps — drive the Rhino and the trophy should follow from using it.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan the robbery in stealth.
Stay out of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
If you are spotted, back out and try again — detection voids the attempt.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.
steps: Find bank vaults around Leonida and rob 5 of them.
Escape after each one — the robbery only counts if you get away.
Silver: plan the getaway before the robbery, not after.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Find an Armored Truck on the road and rob it.
Escape after the robbery — getting away is part of the trophy.
Block the truck first so it cannot drive off mid-robbery.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida.
steps: Visit every region of the state — Vice City, the coast, the swamps and the small towns.
The map fills in as you go; the trophy pops when the last area is discovered.
Pair this with the WAiNK and vehicle cleanup so no trip is wasted.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Find the illegal operations run by each of Leonida's gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.
The official description does not name the gangs or the spots — follow the world markers.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

Sit, drink and enjoy the view — the trophy is the moment, not a mission.

Follow through on your throw — the trophy is about the bowling, so finish a game there.

steps: Reach the story decision the description points at and make the call.
MISSABLE: a choice, once made, may not come again in the same playthrough — think before you pick, and keep a save from before it.
The official description does not name the decision; the story will make it obvious when it arrives.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm.
steps: Something in the game takes two tries — the description is a riddle, not a set of steps.
When a first attempt at an event or encounter fails or falls short, go back and try it a second time.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened?
steps: A hidden, strange event somewhere in Leonida triggers this one.
The official description gives no place — explore the odd corners of the map and the trophy will find you.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: While driving, hit pedestrians with a melee weapon from the vehicle.
Line the car up, swing as you pass and keep moving.
A slow drive through a crowd is more reliable than speed.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Earn Marked Bills, then launder them through your contacts.
Keep laundering until $250,000 is clean.
This is a money grind — it falls naturally out of heists and robberies in stage 3.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
steps: Buy things in shops across Leonida until $100,000 is spent.
Cars, clothes, weapons and food all count.
Save the big purchases for stage 3 and the money will already be there.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties.
steps: Buy every garage property the game sells.
The official description does not name how many there are — check the property listings as you earn money.
Garages also give you somewhere to keep the 100 vehicles for the discovery trophy.
trophies.guide_note: Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles to it.
Register 10 different vehicles.
Use cars you already own so nothing here costs extra.
